name: Software Freedom Day

meta.title: Software Freedom Day 2026
meta.description: A worldwide celebration of free and open source software, on Saturday 19 September 2026. Free to attend, no experience needed. Find a location near you or host your own.

intro: A worldwide celebration of free and open source software. One day a year, in cities all over the world, people get together to show anyone who's curious what free software can do at home, at work, at school and in government.

beginners.label: Who it's for
beginners.heading: Not sure what open source means? You already use it.
beginners.body: It quietly runs the web, your phone and probably half the apps you opened today. Come and find out what that means. No experience needed, and nobody will assume you have any.

worldwide.label: Everywhere else
worldwide.heading: The same day, in dozens of countries
worldwide.body: Software Freedom Day is coordinated worldwide by the Digital Freedom Foundation. If you're not near a location listed here, there may already be one closer than you think.

organise.label: Never organised anything?
organise.heading: We'll walk you through it
organise.body: A short guide on picking a room, what to put on the USBs, and how to let people know it's happening.
